title: OBS
hero_prompt: A hand-etched engraving of a camera obscura chamber: a man performs at a workbench lit by one hard beam of light, his image projected inverted onto a screen beside him exactly as it falls, dense cross-hatched ink shading, technical woodcut style, monochrome with a single amber highlight.
icon_prompt: Square bold emblem: a single thick black aperture-iris shape opening onto a small lens circle, engraving style reduced to bold high-contrast geometric shapes, no fine crosshatching. A flat single-colour silhouette on a plain ground: no shading, no gradients, no glossy highlights, no fine lines; one bold shape that reads at 24 pixels.
